title: The King Discovers
setup: Your rook on h1 stares up the h-file at the black king, and the piece in the way is your own king.
hint: Anything at all can stand in front of a battery, even a king. Which square keeps every flight covered?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kg6#}} is a discovered check: the king steps off the h-file and the rook checks from h1. g7 and h7 are covered by the king itself, g8 by the bishop on b3, and nothing can block on the empty h-file. Kg5 discovers the same check, but then g7 is free.
